observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera body with a Tamron lens attached, placed on bubble wrap. The camera has a small LCD screen, mode dial, and various buttons. A Canon battery and charger are visible in front of the camera.
The camera body appears to be a DSLR with a top LCD screen, mode dial, and control buttons typical of a Canon DSLR.
The lens has 'Tamron' branding and '24-70mm' visible on the barrel.
The charger and battery are labeled 'Canon' and appear to be standard battery packs.
The background includes a box with 'Canon' and 'Tamron' branding, suggesting the items are from the same brand.
No visible damage to the camera body or lens in the photos.
The seller claims it is a Canon 5D Mark III body alone with charger and battery.

identity.kind: Canon DSLR camera body with Tamron lens, battery, and charger

claims.claim: Canon 5D Mark III body alone with Charger and the battery.
claims.evidence: The camera body appears to be a Canon DSLR, but the model is not clearly visible. The lens is a Tamron, not Canon. The charger and battery are present, but their compatibility with the camera body is not confirmed. The seller's claim of '5D Mark III' cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera body is not a Canon 5D Mark III, but a different model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera's model name on the body, or a photo of the camera's serial number and model label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Canon DSLR body, not as a 5D Mark III.

risks.risk: The lens is not a Canon lens, but a Tamron lens.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens's nameplate or a close-up of the lens barrel showing the brand.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a Tamron lens, not as a Canon lens.

risks.risk: The battery and charger are not compatible with the camera body.
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery and charger inserted into the camera's battery compartment, or a photo of the camera's battery compartment with the battery inserted.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-functional or incompatible set.

risks.risk: The camera has a high shutter count or is damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera's shutter count display (if available) or a video showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used camera with unknown shutter count, possibly degraded.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the camera's model name on the body or the serial number.
A photo of the lens's nameplate or close-up of the lens barrel showing the brand.
A photo of the battery and charger inserted into the camera's battery compartment.
A video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
